definitions.text_mt: Ġerrej: Persuna li tirkeb iż-żwiemel fiċ-ċirku tat-tiġrijiet, speċjalment bħala professjoni.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ġerrej rebaħ it-tellieqa bl-iż-żiemel favorit tiegħu.
usage_examples.text_en: The jockey won the race with his favourite horse.

usage_examples.text_mt: Wieħed mis-subien jixtieq isir ġerrej meta jikber.
usage_examples.text_en: One of the boys wants to become a jockey when he grows up.

definitions.text_mt: Ġerriegħ: Persuna li tiżra’ z-żerriegħa fl-art, speċjalment għall-għelejq.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ġerriegħ xerred iz-żerriegħa bir-reqqa fl-għelieqi kollha.
usage_examples.text_en: The sower scattered the seed carefully across all the fields.

usage_examples.text_mt: L-imgħallem kien ġerriegħ ta’ għerf fost l-istudenti tiegħu.
usage_examples.text_en: The teacher was a sower of wisdom among his students.

definitions.text_mt: Ġerriegħi: Li jista’ jittollera jew jissaporti uġigħ jew diffikultà mingħajr ma jilmenta.

usage_examples.text_mt: Missieri huwa bniedem ġerriegħi u qatt ma jilmenta.
usage_examples.text_en: My father is a tolerant man and never complains.

usage_examples.text_mt: Is-sitwazzjoni kienet ġerriegħja, imma aħna bqajna siekta.
usage_examples.text_en: The situation was tolerable, but we remained quiet.

definitions.text_mt: Ġeru: Kelb żgħir, speċjalment wieħed li għadu qed jirda’.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-kelb tagħna welldet ġeru żgħir ilbieraħ filgħodu.
usage_examples.text_en: Our dog gave birth to a small puppy yesterday morning.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ġeru kien qed jilgħab bil-ballun fil-ġnien.
usage_examples.text_en: The puppy was playing with the ball in the garden.

definitions.text_mt: Ġerħ: L-azzjoni li wieħed iferri jew iweġġa’ lil xi ħadd jew annimal.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ġerħ tal-annimal kien ħazin u bżaġa.
usage_examples.text_en: The wounding of the animal was cruel and frightening.

definitions.text_mt: Ġerħa: Ferita fil-ġisem, speċjalment waħda kkawżata minn strument li jaqta’ jew minn daqqa.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ġerħa fuq saqqu damet ġimgħat biex fejqet.
usage_examples.text_en: The wound on his leg took weeks to heal.

usage_examples.text_mt: Dik il-ġerħa qatt ma fejqet għalkemm għaddiet ġimgħat.
usage_examples.text_en: That bruise never healed even though weeks passed.

usage_examples.text_mt: It-tabib ħejjeġ il-ġerħa u libes faxxa madwar id-driegħ.
usage_examples.text_en: The doctor dressed the wound and wrapped a bandage around the arm.

definitions.text_mt: Ġest: Moviment tal-idejn, tar-ras jew tal-ġisem biex jesprima xi ħsieb jew sentiment.
Ġest: Azzjoni magħmula biex turi ġentilezza, rispett jew ħbiberija.

usage_examples.text_mt: B’ġest sempliċi ta’ idu wrieh it-triq it-tajba.
usage_examples.text_en: With a simple gesture of his hand he showed him the right way.

usage_examples.text_mt: Kien ġest sabiħ li offra li jħallas għall-ikla tagħna.
usage_examples.text_en: It was a kind gesture to offer to pay for our meal.

definitions.text_mt: Ġestikulazzjoni: Moviment ħajjiel tal-idejn u l-ġisem waqt li wieħed jitkellem, speċjalment meta jkun eċċitat.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ġestikulazzjoni tiegħu kienet ħajjiela waqt id-diskors.
usage_examples.text_en: His gesticulation was lively during the speech.

usage_examples.text_mt: Minn barra l-kamra, stajna naraw il-ġestikulazzjonijiet tiegħu mit-tieqa.
usage_examples.text_en: From outside the room, we could see his gesticulations through the window.

etymology_chain.term: Jisù ~ Gisù with the e-coloured Italian Gesù

definitions.text_mt: Ġesù: Il-figura ċentrali tal-Kristjaneżmu, meqjus mill-Kristjani bħala l-iben ta’ Alla u s-salvatur tal-bniedem.

usage_examples.text_mt: Ġesù twieled f’Betlem u trabba f’Nazaret.
usage_examples.text_en: Jesus was born in Bethlehem and grew up in Nazareth.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-Kristjani jemmnu li Ġesù miet u qam mill-imwiet għall-fidwa tal-bniedem.
usage_examples.text_en: Christians believe that Jesus died and rose from the dead for the redemption of mankind.

usage_examples.text_mt: L-istorja ta’ Ġesù hija rrakkontata fl-Evanġelji tal-Bibbja.
usage_examples.text_en: The story of Jesus is told in the Gospels of the Bible.

definitions.text_mt: Ġesù Kristu: Il-figura ċentrali tal-Kristjaneżmu, meqjus mill-Kristjani bħala l-iben ta’ Alla u s-salvatur tal-bniedem.

usage_examples.text_mt: Ġesù Kristu huwa meqjus mill-Kristjani bħala l-iben ta’ Alla.
usage_examples.text_en: Jesus Christ is regarded by Christians as the son of God.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-festa ta’ Ġesù Kristu Re tiġi ċċelebrata f’Novembru.
usage_examples.text_en: The feast of Christ the King is celebrated in November.

definitions.text_mt: Ġew: Fil-parti ta’ ġewwa; mhux barra.
Ġew: Ma'; f'nofs.

usage_examples.text_mt: Ommi kienet ġew meta wasalt id-dar.
usage_examples.text_en: My mother was inside when I arrived home.

definitions.text_mt: Ġew: Fil-limiti ta’ xi ħaġa; fil-parti ta’ ġewwa.
Ġew: Ma' jew fost; f'nofs.

usage_examples.text_mt: Poġġejt il-ktieb ġew il-kexxun.
usage_examples.text_en: I put the book inside the drawer.

usage_examples.text_mt: It-tfal damu ġew id-dar il-jiem kollha tax-xita.
usage_examples.text_en: The children stayed inside the house all the rainy days.

definitions.text_en: a wicker basket, typically with a handle
definitions.text_mt: Ġewlaq: Basket tal-qasab jew tal-qroll, ħafna drabi b’manku, użat biex iġorr jew iħżomm affarijiet.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-bidwi ġarr il-ward u l-frott fil-ġewlaq tal-qasab.
usage_examples.text_en: The farmer carried the flowers and fruit in the wicker basket.

usage_examples.text_mt: Xtrajt ġewlaq ġdid mis-suq għall-ġnien.
usage_examples.text_en: I bought a new wicker basket from the market for the garden.

definitions.text_mt: Ġewnaħ: Parti tal-ġisem ta’ għasfur, insett jew annimal ieħor użata għat-titjir.
Ġewnaħ: Parti mill-ajruplan li tipprovdi l-irfigh.
Ġewnaħ: Naħa ta’ bini jew struttura fuq kull naħa ta’ punt ċentrali.
Ġewnaħ: Spazju triangulari bejn l-arkata u l-qafas ta’ bini.
Ġewnaħ: Protezzjoni jew kenn mogħti minn xi ħadd.

usage_examples.text_mt: L-għasfur kellu ġewnaħ imkisser u ma setax itir.
usage_examples.text_en: The bird had a broken wing and could not fly.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ġewnaħ tal-ajruplan kien twil u eleganti.
usage_examples.text_en: The wing of the aeroplane was long and elegant.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-familja kollha ġiet taħt il-ġewnaħ ta’ nannuhom.
usage_examples.text_en: The whole family came under the protection of their grandfather.

definitions.text_mt: Ġewwa: Fil-parti ta’ ġew; mhux barra; fid-dar jew f’post magħluq.

usage_examples.text_mt: It-tfal kienu ġewwa meta bdiet ix-xita.
usage_examples.text_en: The children were inside when it started raining.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-qtates iħobbu jibqgħu ġewwa meta jkun kiesaħ.
usage_examples.text_en: Cats like to stay indoors when it is cold.

definitions.text_mt: Ġewwa: Ġo; fil-limiti ta’; f’nofs xi ħaġa.
Ġewwa: Matul; fil-mijiet ta’; fost.

usage_examples.text_mt: It-teżor kien moħbi ġewwa l-kaxxa tal-injam.
usage_examples.text_en: The treasure was hidden inside the wooden box.

usage_examples.text_mt: Hemm ħafna ħut ġewwa l-baħar Mediterran.
usage_examples.text_en: There are many fish in the Mediterranean Sea.

definitions.text_mt: Ġewwaħ: Ħalla lil xi ħadd mingħajr ikel għal żmien twil, ħafna drabi sal-mewt.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-gwerra ġewħet lill-poplu kollu għal xhur sħaħ.
usage_examples.text_en: The war starved the entire population for months on end.

usage_examples.text_mt: Minflok ma ġewwaħ lill-annimal, kellu jitmgħu kif jixraq.
usage_examples.text_en: Instead of starving the animal, he should have fed it properly.

definitions.text_mt: Ġewwenija: Is-sens ta’ dak li hu tajjeb u ħazin fl-imġieba tal-bniedem.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ġewwenija tiegħu ma ħallietux jorgod wara dak li għamel.
usage_examples.text_en: His conscience did not let him sleep after what he did.

definitions.text_mt: Ġewwieni: Li jinsab ġewwa; mhux ta’ barra; relatat mal-parti ta’ ġewwa.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-bitħa ta’ ġewwa kienet mimlija fjuri u siġar.
usage_examples.text_en: The inner courtyard was full of flowers and trees.

usage_examples.text_mt: Is-sliem ta’ ġewwa huwa importanti daqs is-sliem ta’ barra.
usage_examples.text_en: Inner peace is as important as outer peace.

definitions.text_mt: Ġewwieni: Persuna relatata ma’ oħra permezz ta’ demm jew żwieġ.
Ġewwieni: L-organi interni tal-ġisem, speċjalment tal-istonku u l-musrana.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ġewwiena tiegħu nġabru biex jiċċelebraw l-għors.
usage_examples.text_en: His relatives gathered to celebrate the wedding.

usage_examples.text_mt: It-tabib eżamina l-ġewwiena tal-pazjent permezz tal-ultraħoss.
usage_examples.text_en: The doctor examined the patient’s entrails through ultrasound.

definitions.text_mt: Ġewwinija: Is-sens ta’ dak li hu tajjeb u ħazin fl-imġieba tal-bniedem.

usage_examples.text_mt: Kull wieħed għandu ġewwinija li tgħinu jagħmel l-għażla t-tajba.
usage_examples.text_en: Everyone has a conscience to help them make the right choice.

definitions.text_mt: Ġewħan: Li għandu aptit qawwi għall-ikel; li għandu ġuħ.

usage_examples.text_mt: Wara l-mixja twila, uliedi kienu ġewħana u għajjiena.
usage_examples.text_en: After the long walk, my children were hungry and tired.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-qtates ġewħana kienu qed jimjaw madwar il-platt tal-ikel.
usage_examples.text_en: The hungry cats were meowing around the food bowl.

definitions.text_mt: Ġewż: Frott bi qoxra iebsa u ġewġiena li tittiekel, bħall-lewż u l-ġellewż.
Ġewż: Speċifikament, il-ġewż tal-ġandar (Juglans regia).

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ġewż frisk mis-suq kien ta’ kwalità eċċellenti din is-sena.
usage_examples.text_en: The fresh nuts from the market were of excellent quality this year.

usage_examples.text_mt: Xtrajt borza ġewż tal-ġandar għall-kejk tal-Milied.
usage_examples.text_en: I bought a bag of walnuts for the Christmas cake.

definitions.text_mt: Ġewżaq: Għodda żgħira ta’ injam jew plastik, fit-tond u dejqa fin-nofs, użata biex jitgeżwer il-ħajt għad-drap u x-xogħol tal-ħjata.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-ġewżaq kien mimli ħajt abjad u lesti għad-drap.
usage_examples.text_en: The bobbin was full of white thread and ready for weaving.

usage_examples.text_mt: In-nanna ħallietli l-ġwieżaq tagħha tal-injam bħala wirt.
usage_examples.text_en: My grandmother left me her wooden bobbins as an inheritance.

definitions.text_en: Jehovah (name of God in the Hebrew Scriptures)
definitions.text_mt: Ġeħova: Isem ta’ Alla fit-Testment il-Qadim, użat minn xi denominazzjonijiet Insara.

usage_examples.text_mt: Ix-Xhieda ta’ Ġeħova jippritkaw mill-bieb għall-bieb.
usage_examples.text_en: Jehovah’s Witnesses preach from door to door.

usage_examples.text_mt: Fil-Bibbja, Ġeħova hu spiss imsejjaħ ‘Alla tal-eżerċti’.
usage_examples.text_en: In the Bible, Jehovah is often called the God of Hosts.
